description: The verse numberings (KVN mappings) the tools can read references in and number answers in, for the mapping argument of get_passage, get_original_text, get_cross_references, check_references and others. Bible editions number some verses differently — whether a psalm heading is a verse, where a chapter breaks — and a reference copied from one edition can point at another verse in the site's own numbering (osnb). Find the id by the edition's name or language, e.g. "king james", "dnb2024", "german", "swahili".

query.description: Words the id or the name must contain, e.g. "king james", "dnb", "nynorsk", "german", "spanish". Default: none, which lists the named numberings and then every id.

name: list_verse_mappings
title: List verse numberings
